vendors.offering: CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM export for monitored open-source and container projects

vendors.pricing: free tier plus Business tier; amount not verified

vendors.name: ReversingLabs Spectra Assure

vendors.name: SOOS
vendors.offering: SCA with SBOM generation and management

paid_market_gaps.gap: Generators disagree and omit dependencies; no vendor sells verified-accurate SBOMs across ecosystems
30-70% of manually installed packages in Docker images missed by common SBOM tools
SBOM export locked to Snyk Enterprise; SMBs needing compliance SBOMs pay enterprise prices
Binary/commercial-component SBOM coverage gated to higher ReversingLabs tiers; C/C++ builds poorly served

wtp_evidence: Generation itself is free (Syft, GitHub, Docker, Inspector); buyers pay only inside SCA/management bundles such as Snyk Enterprise or Anchore, not for generation alone.
bundling_note: GitHub exports SBOMs for anyone and AWS Inspector exports CycloneDX/SPDX at no extra cost, so basic generation is already free.
summary: Not a standalone business: generation is commoditized by OSS and bundled free by GitHub, Docker and AWS. Only an accuracy/verification layer for hard ecosystems (C/C++, binaries, hand-installed packages) might sell to regulated device makers.

vendors.name: Docker Scout
vendors.offering: Uses build-time SBOM attestations on images for policy and vulnerability analysis

paid_market_gaps.gap: Artifact attestations for private repos require GitHub Enterprise Cloud; smaller teams can't tie SBOMs to releases cheaply
Management platforms mostly quote-only; few transparent-priced options for small manufacturers facing CRA SBOM duties
Inspector exports only CycloneDX 1.4; bundled exports lag current CycloneDX spec and VEX
SBOM-based vulnerability management yields noisy results; VEX workflow to suppress false positives remains immature

wtp_evidence: Regulated buyers pay: Manifest signed a multi-year SaaS SBOM deal with a public medical device maker and raised $15M; Anchore lists around $34.5k/yr on AWS Marketplace.
bundling_note: GitHub and Docker already bundle SBOM attestations at build, but cross-vendor SBOM/VEX lifecycle management and regulator-facing workflows are not given away by platforms.
summary: Modest opening: SBOM+VEX lifecycle management for SMB manufacturers facing EU CRA (Dec 2027) and FDA 524B, with transparent pricing. Crowded with funded specialists (Anchore, Manifest, Interlynk); attestation alone is bundled by GitHub/Docker.
